dataRecordMapping.description:
Provides a mapping from a data record returned by an api call, which may be in any shape,
to the shape required by the concrete data spec setting type implementation.

fieldName.description: The name of the field to which these settings apply

fieldFontLarge.description: Displays large font size for field values if true.

valueIconMap.description:
Map of data to icon class.
The icon class is when concatenated with `fa-` yields the
Font Awesome icon to render.

Example:
if class = 'hashtag', the Font Awesome icon to render is `fa-hashtag`

labelIcon.description: The name of the icon for the label.

tooltipText.description: Text for the tooltip displayed off of the icon in the header.

subInfo.description: Text that provides some secondary information

placeholder.description: A placeholder to be used when the field is null and thus undefined client-side.

truncate.description: Whether the value of the field should be truncated.

redirectLink.description:
The url to which the user is redirected upon clicking the field value.

TODO: UI-8456 Replace this value type with the new link configuration type.

title:
A specification that describes how to display each field of the {@link UiSdlDefinitionListDataSpec}
in the {@link UiSdlDefinitionList}.
name: UiSdlDefinitionListDataSpecFieldSetting
